cases.estimand: Cellwise intercept-free non-negative least squares of a normalized response map on normalized predictor maps; keyed non-negative coefficients that are not mixture weights
conventions: Mass predictors/response on one nominal grid
intercept-free: eyesim ignores intercept = TRUE for nnls
full column rank required; no dropped predictors
backend_dependencies: native Lawson-Hanson active set over Householder QR
cases.independent_case: Exact rational enumeration of every active set's normal equations, keeping the unique KKT solution: interior (708/1399, 9264/18187), boundary (1070/1131, 50/377, 0) and an exact equal mixture (1/2, 1/2).

cases.estimand: Partial Spearman correlation of the source map with the baseline map given the reference map, and with the reference given the baseline, over cells
conventions: no p-values: cells are not independent replicates
undefined when a map is constant or explained by the covariates
backend_dependencies: native residual partial correlation over Householder QR
cases.independent_case: Exact rational average ranks and inverse covariance matrix, with the square root taken last, for tied and untied maps; the same oracle checks ppcor's Pearson route.
cases.divergence: Values agree with eyesim, but eyesim returns these partial correlations as beta_baseline and beta_source regression weights. eyes4s returns a separate PartialAssociation result that is never labelled a coefficient, and reports an undefined association as None.
